Product Description
Product Technical 
DTB Series of Brinell hardness testers are classified according to depth sensors (Analog/Digital).
DTB-500 has manual system and is driven by manual pump
They are applied to the ISO-4498-1, ISO-6506-2 and ISO 17025. They are precise and reliable so that will be able to be used in Lab. And produce line of wide range of industry\Force gauge
Loads changeable manually
Manually loading operation
Brinell value with scope
